meta.name: CIA Discovery UI Preview
meta.status: Discovery UI/UX refinement - bounded and aligned profile/blacklist fields
meta.basis: Approved Discovery requirements/architecture plus user-approved UI refinements

responsive.baseline: Matches approved Load responsive breakpoint and minimum-window philosophy.
responsive.behavior: At widths below 1180, move the whole Discovery right rail below the tag list. The lower rail keeps Tag Preview and Discovery Settings side-by-side at approximately 60/40.

behavior: Right rail remains on the right but all internal controls become fully fluid.
General categories stack into one column.
Tag Preview occurrence navigation may wrap rather than clip.
Settings management fields/buttons shrink inside available width.

sorting.interaction: Single-column sorting through the Tag, Database Tag, Occurrences, Sources and Sample Value headers.
sorting.visibleState: The active header displays an ascending or descending arrow; inactive sortable headers display a bidirectional indicator.

sourceInspection.entryPoint: Each Sources value is an inspectable compact affordance in its tag row.
sourceInspection.presentation: A scrollable flyout lists every contributing source using a typed source ID, source name and per-source occurrence count.
sourceInspection.aggregateCheck: The flyout shows contributor count and summed occurrences and explicitly confirms they match the row aggregate.
sourceInspection.tagPreviewBoundary: Source contributor detail does not appear in Tag Preview.

leftDiscoveryArea.cancellation: Esc only; no on-screen Cancel button

topRow.wrap: single row at normal width; wrap only when horizontal space requires it

leftDiscoveryArea.controlRowResponsive: Search, filter, profile dropdown and selected/total count remain left-aligned and wrap only when needed.
leftDiscoveryArea.databaseTagVisibility: The resulting Database Tag Name is always visible in the list. When no override exists it shows the discovered tag name; when overridden it shows the override with modified styling.
leftDiscoveryArea.exclusionPresentation: Do not use a generic Exclude button that looks equivalent to selection. Use a distinct Blacklist action/state because selection and explicit exclusion are separate semantics.

filtering.search: free-text tag/value search remains in the control row
filtering.blacklistedVisibility: controlled from Discovery Settings > General > List View
filtering.databaseTagOverrideOnly: controlled from Discovery Settings > General > List View

tagPreview.purpose: Show only the string/text value contained by the selected discovered tag occurrence.
tagPreview.automaticBehavior: Preview follows the selected tag and occurrence automatically.
tagPreview.contentPresentation: Single plain-text value only. No derived Short/Long/field decomposition, no raw XML, no source metadata clutter.
tagPreview.occurrenceCountDuplication: Do not repeat occurrence totals elsewhere inside Tag Preview; total appears in occurrence navigation only.

databaseTagNameOverride.placement: Compact control below preview value, styled consistently with Load controls.

responsiveSizing.occurrenceNavigator: flex-wrap allowed before the full right rail moves below

general.layout: Two category columns: Workflow on the left, List View on the right. Options stack vertically within each category.

Workflow.label: Open Database when creation completes
Workflow.behavior: Navigate to Database after successful explicit Database creation/update.

Workflow.label: Confirm before re-running Discovery when Database is current
Workflow.behavior: Warn before a re-run makes the current Database out of date.

List View.label: Show blacklisted tags
List View.behavior: When off, blacklisted rows are hidden from the discovered-tag list.

List View.label: Show only selected
List View.behavior: When on, show only currently selected discovered tags.

List View.label: Show only tags with Database Tag Name Override
List View.behavior: When on, show only rows whose Database Tag Name differs from the discovered tag.

profiles.alwaysVisibleOutsideTab: Selection Profile load dropdown above tag list
profiles.managementLayout: Centered label/control block. Active profile field max width matches the two-button block width (264px). Buttons remain centered below the field.

blacklist.managementLayout: Centered label/control block. Blacklist dropdown max width matches the two-button block width (264px). Buttons remain centered below the dropdown.

discoverySettings.style: Use the same compact visual language as approved Load UI: small outline/ghost controls, compact dropdowns, tight spacing, no large full-width action buttons.
discoverySettings.responsiveFields: Profile/Blacklist fields are capped at 264px but shrink below that when the panel becomes narrower; no change to the v0.9 responsive stacking/compression behavior.

databasePublication.placement: Bottom of Discovery Settings as persistent in-context footer
